title: Clean Marketing / Landing System
license: MIT (original work, created for this project)
use_when: public-facing products: landing pages, marketing sites, waitlists

layout.structure: sticky top nav (72px) + full-bleed hero + feature grid + social proof + footer
layout.hero: two-column on desktop (copy + product visual), stacked on mobile
layout.sections: alternating bg and surface_alt, 96px vertical padding desktop / 56px mobile

components.button_primary: bg color_primary, white text, radius, padding 12px 24px, hover color_primary_hover
components.feature_card: surface white, radius, shadow_card, icon + h3 + 2-line body
components.nav: logo left, links center, CTA right; collapses to hamburger on mobile

usability_rules: single primary CTA above the fold
visible focus rings on all interactive elements
